headline: ConnectOne Bancorp Expands Margins and Executes $750 Million Loan Sale in Q3
summary: ConnectOne Bancorp reported improved third-quarter profitability driven by net interest margin expansion and the completion of a $750 million loan portfolio sale.
why: Loan portfolio sales help regional banks optimize balance-sheet liquidity and manage credit risk exposure.

impacts.name: ConnectOne Bancorp, Inc.
impacts.why: Margin expansion and liquidity generated from loan sales enhance capital ratios and profitability.
